answer: A stake-weighted endorsement graph resists Sybils: an agent's influence grows only from endorsements by peers who themselves hold bonded reputation, so a swarm of fresh fake identities starts with zero weight. An attacker trying to forge a whole atlas of fake histories faces a steep ledge: each identity must earn real, costly endorsements before it counts. Genuine reputation, like jade, is hard to counterfeit at scale because every endorsement is traceable and slashable when proven false.
